request.questionText: The Quibbler magazine is considering the launch of a digital edition, but only if the editor can be convinced that more subscribers would upgrade than the historical new-feature conversion rate of 19% would indicate. The staff poll a random sample of 270 subscribers, of whom 58 expressed interest in upgrading to digital. Use Monte Carlo simulation with 100000 iterations to calculate a p-value under the appropriate null hypothesis. What is the estimated p-value? Enter your answer in percentage units rounded to the nearest percent. For example, enter 99 for an answer of ninety-nine percent.
